attributes.name: Inger-Maggor
attributes.powers:
Before you act, each other character at your location must succeed at a Stealth or Survival 12 check or expend 1d4-1 mythic charges and summon and build the location Maze and move to it.

If this is the first exploration of your turn, the difficulty to defeat Inger-Maggor is increased by 1d20.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
